about: Pinned build toolchain of the release workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml): the launcher is built on a GitHub Windows runner with these, nothing else is downloaded. fetch_toolchain.py downloads each entry, checks its SHA-256 and unpacks it under work/release/toolchain-cache/trees/<name>/. '{version}' in a URL is the entry's own field. sha256 TO-FILL = never fetched (fetch_toolchain.py --fill records it); pin TO-CONFIRM = version not checked against the release page yet. Versions follow the Killzone 3 port's toolchain.json (same author) where it pins the same tool. Only SDL3.dll and the Python embeddable package (with their licence texts) reach the release zip; the compiler, CMake and Ninja never ship.

components.name: llvm-mingw
components.license: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception (clang, lld, compiler-rt, libc++, libunwind); MinGW-w64 and winpthreads under their own permissive terms; build scripts ISC
components.about: The C++ compiler for the launcher (clang++, lld, windres). Hash from a download on 2026-11-03, equal to the Killzone 3 port's pin of the same file.

components.name: llvm-mingw-linux
components.license: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception (clang, lld, compiler-rt, libc++, libunwind); MinGW-w64 and winpthreads under their own permissive terms; build scripts ISC
components.about: CI only (ci.yml launcher-build on ubuntu-latest): the same llvm-mingw release built for a Linux host, so every push cross-compiles the launcher for Windows the way the release does (fetch_toolchain.py --only llvm-mingw-linux,sdl3). Never fetched by release.yml. Hash from a download on 2026-11-03.

components.name: sdl3
components.about: SDL3's official MinGW development package: headers, import library and CMake config for the launcher build, and x86_64-w64-mingw32/bin/SDL3.dll plus LICENSE.txt, which go into the zip. The same SDL version the Killzone 3 port pins. Hash from a download on 2026-11-03, equal to the digest GitHub shows for the release asset.

components.name: cmake
components.about: Configures the launcher build. Hash from a download on 2026-11-03, in Kitware's published SHA-256 list and equal to the Killzone 3 port's pin.

components.name: ninja
components.about: Runs the launcher compile. Hash from a download on 2026-11-03, equal to the Killzone 3 port's pin.

components.name: python
components.license: PSF-2.0 (its LICENSE.txt also carries the terms of the libraries CPython bundles)
components.about: The Python embeddable package (Windows x64) that runs the launcher's engine, tools/release/catalog.py (standard library only). Unpacked to python/ in the zip, its LICENSE.txt also in licenses/. Hash from a download on 2026-11-03, equal to the Killzone 3 port's pin of the same file.
